Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Jill. They were playing at the park together. Suddenly, Jack had an idea. He wanted to try and find something to put on his shoes. Jill was scared.

"What do you want to do?" asked Jack.

"Let's go for a walk," said Jill.

They walked over to the park and saw something rare - a tree.

"I can see what's behind the tree," said Jill.

"It's a great place," said Jack.

So, Jill and Jack climbed the tree
